title: Table 4. Formulas for ENOB improvement
text_helper: Table 4. Formulas for ENOB improvement — section 6 ENOB (effective number of bits) measurement. Method, Formula (X is the ADC resolution OSR is the oversampling ratio).

headers: Formula (X is the ADC resolution OSR is the oversampling ratio)
rows: Resolution = X + (ln (OSR) / ln(2)) – M M is the division coefficient of the hardware oversampling engine
notes: 1. Bold entries have no significance since the hardware oversampling unit output is limited to 16-bit data width. AN5537 - Rev 2 page 21/29
